//: The leaner variant: Claude Code's native `http` hook type POSTs the raw hook JSON straight to notipet, with no CLI process in the middle. Fastest path, nothing to install on PATH.
//1: REQUIRES a pinned port. notipet defaults to server.port = 0 (ephemeral), which makes port conflicts impossible but leaves no stable URL. Set "server": { "port": 47811 } in %LOCALAPPDATA%\notipet\settings.json before using this file, and restart the daemon.
//2: The daemon still requires a bearer token on /hooks/*, so this only works if Claude Code is configured to send one - otherwise use settings.hooks.example.json, where the CLI reads the token out of runtime.json for you.
